title: Wisconet API v1 Wrapper
text: rwisconet provides interface Wisconet v1 API (https://wisconet.wisc.edu/api/v1). Supports fetching station metadata, available field definitions, observation data one stations.

title: Wisconet API v1 Wrapper
code: remotes::install_github("bzbradford/rwisconet")

title: Wisconet API v1 Wrapper
text: Creating new client automatically fetches station field metadata API. Default timezone “America/Chicago” interpreting date/time ranges conversion UTC local time. can skip initial metadata fetch use different timezone, normally leave default settings.
code: suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(tidyverse)) library(rwisconet)  # initialize the connection wn <- Wisconet$new() wn <- Wisconet$new(timezone = "US/Eastern", fetch_on_init = FALSE)

title: Wisconet API v1 Wrapper
text: Several configutation options available wn$config object. example, timezone stored wn$config$timezone. several configuration options can set affect throttling, concurrency, retry behavior API calls Wisconet. can set like wn$config${config_name} <- {config_value}, default values work fine. See config options values executing wn wn$print():
code: wn #> <Wisconet API> #>   Stations: 79  #>   Fields: 264  #>   Config: #>     timezone: America/Chicago #>     capacity: 20 #>     fill_time_s: 20 #>     max_tries: 5 #>     max_concurrent: 10

title: Wisconet API v1 Wrapper
text: station metadata table stored wn$stations. can refresh time wn$get_stations(). Find nearest station(s) given point: Display stations interactive map (requires leaflet package):
code: # extract the stations table stns <- wn$stations  # view it glimpse(stns) #> Rows: 79 #> Columns: 15 #> $ station_id        <chr> "ANGO", "ALTN", "RTHR", "BBCK", "BYFD", "BLCR", "WCR… #> $ station_slug      <chr> "antigo", "arlington", "arthur", "babcock", "bayfiel… #> $ station_name      <chr> "Antigo", "Arlington", "Arthur", "Babcock", "Bayfiel… #> $ latitude          <dbl> 45.15890, 43.29660, 45.03200, 44.25380, 46.83950, 44… #> $ longitude         <dbl> -89.11780, -89.38430, -91.20000, -90.26900, -91.0136… #> $ elevation         <dbl> 461, 304, 307, 296, 321, 238, 262, 338, 366, 253, 23… #> $ location          <chr> "Langlade County Airport", "Arlington Agricultural R… #> $ station_timezone  <chr> "US/Central", "US/Central", "US/Central", "US/Centra… #> $ city              <chr> "Antigo", "Arlington", "Arthur", "Babcock", "Bayfiel… #> $ county            <chr> "Langlade", "Columbia County", "Chippewa", "Wood", "… #> $ region            <chr> "Northeast", "South Central", "Northwest", "Central"… #> $ state             <chr> "WI", "WI", "WI", "WI", "WI", "WI", "WI", "WI", "WI"… #> $ earliest_api_date <date> 2024-09-11, 2023-05-22, 2024-08-28, 2024-07-11, 202… #> $ madis_id          <chr> "WIANT", "WIALT", "WIRTR", "WIBBK", "WIFYD", "WIBLK"… #> $ climate_division  <chr> "Northeast", "South Central", "Northwest", "Central"… # will return the nearest 3 stations to this point and the distance wn$find_nearest_station(lat = 43.07, lng = -89.40, n = 3) #> # A tibble: 3 × 5 #>   station_id station_name latitude longitude dist_km #>   <chr>      <chr>           <dbl>     <dbl>   <dbl> #> 1 OJNR       Verona           43.0     -89.5    12.2 #> 2 ALTN       Arlington        43.3     -89.4    25.3 #> 3 GLCP       Porter           42.8     -89.2    36.3 library(leaflet)  # title: Wisconet API v1 Wrapper
text: examples use lubridate functions convenient date time ranges pulling data Wisconet. today() function returns today’s date, now() function returns current date time. can also set start end date specifically using format “YYYY-MM-DD” like start_date = "2026-01-01". specify start/end time, use format “YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS” using 24-hour notation, like “2026-01-01 12:00:00” noon. Times assumed US Central time unless timezone option changed. use date don’t specify time, return entire day.

what: Get data for a single station
title: Wisconet API v1 Wrapper
text: Use get_measures() fetch data one station. Provide station ID, vector field standard_name values, time window. Returned data formatted tibble station measure metadata. , use specific date/time range. Format like “YYYY-MM-DD” “YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS” (using 24 hour time). time ommitted assumes want full day (midnight - midnight local time).

what: Use specific start/end times per station
title: Wisconet API v1 Wrapper
text: can also pass named list per-station start end times need collect data different timeframes station.

title: Wisconet API Client — Wisconet
text: R6 class providing interface Wisconet v1 API (https://wisconet.wisc.edu/api/v1). Supports fetching station metadata, available field definitions, observation data one stations.

title: Wisconet API Client — Wisconet
text: stations Tibble station metadata, populated get_stations(). fields Tibble available field definitions, populated get_fields(). config Named list client configuration values: timezone Timezone parsing observation timestamps. Default "America/Chicago". capacity Token-bucket capacity request throttling. Default 20. fill_time_s Seconds refill token bucket. Default 20. max_tries Maximum retry attempts per request. Default 5. max_concurrent Maximum parallel requests get_measures_stations(). Default 10. values can updated time, e.g. client$config$capacity <- 5.

title: Wisconet API Client — Wisconet
text: Wisconet$new() Wisconet$get_stations() Wisconet$find_nearest_station() Wisconet$get_fields() Wisconet$find_fields() Wisconet$get_measures() Wisconet$get_measures_stations() Wisconet$get_measures_all() Wisconet$print() Wisconet$clone()
